push.title: W 3-0 vs Tuh Alec FC | You: 9.7 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Holy guacamole, buddskees. A 9.7. That's the kind of night that ends up on a refrigerator.

THE GOOD
+ 100% passing on 10 attempts, up from your usual 75%. You made possession look easy, and it isn't.
+ 2 shots at Tuh Alec FC's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 1 key pass. Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Man of the Match, your 13th for us. Top performer, top teammate.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 4. Team wins are the best kind.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Keep this in your pocket: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- Passes attempted 10, down from your usual 27. Think about this: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- 1 tackle won cost 0.1. Think before the touch.

Session plan: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Before you go, buddskees: A team that laughs together stays together. Tell a bad joke tomorrow.

That's championship stuff. - Coach Lasso
